anouk-harvey.text: On becoming Lancaster's deputy mayor of education services under Mayor Parris's anti-illiteracy initiative: "Our initiative right now is to work with students so that they can read at a third-grade level by third grade," adding many of her seventh-graders test at kindergarten to second-grade levels.

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: Lancaster hires new deputy mayor of education services (2026-03-31)

julie-ann-bookman.text: As board president, led a resolution (passed 3-1, Dec. 2025) holding trustee Shawn Cannon II accountable for alleged bylaw violations and barring him from board office through 2026: "What this is about today is trying to bring order and civility back to our board meetings so that we can do the business of the district."

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: Eastside resolution targets Cannon (2025-12-12)

julie-ann-bookman.text: As board president, on hiring Superintendent Hamberlin: the district "will continue building on its foundation of excellence by strengthening instructional systems, investing in people, fostering innovation and creating coherent structures that support continuous improvement."

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: EUSD trustees hire new superintendent (2026-07-21)
